7084-8249-8337.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

240-574-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-4927-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

5035-8159.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5035-8159.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B}. Choose to pay an amount of life and create that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Ingris by paying {4}, creating a 2/2 Cadet creature token and giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
Declare all eligible creatures you control as attackers.
Ingris triggers for each attacking creature, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
5035-8159.notes: It's recommended to execute this combo when the number of creatures you control that can attack plus (your life total - 1) is greater than or equal to the highest life total among your opponents. This'll ensure each opponent dies due to the Ingris triggers. You can also deal combat damage with the creatures if they cannot be blocked.

1479-4826-5700-5701-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-7525-7875.easyPrerequisites: Striking Palette must have valid targets.
1170-7525-7875.description:
Cast Striking Palette using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Pigment Wrangler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pigment Wrangler, which enters prepared.
Resolve Striking Palette.
Repeat.

1368-1849-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1849-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2180-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2180-5147-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2609-4050-7496.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
2609-4050-7496.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W} due to its affinity for creatures, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1987-4316-4423-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1987-4316-4423-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

3490-5296-7343-7363.description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {0} due to Mutagen Man, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token and a Mutagen token.
Repeat.

3094-4359-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4359-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

512-4241-7308.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4241-7308.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4217-4668-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.
4217-4668-7302.notes: You can have an opponent draw the first iteration using Whirlwind Technique to get Heliod's cost reduction to {2} to continue the combo

1806-2034-6867-7074.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Scourge and the Ally, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Koh triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.
1806-2034-6867-7074.notes: You can forego sacrificing the Ally during an iteration if mana allows.

394-560-2034-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-560-2034-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1482-2854-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4574-6900.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

539-3967-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1034-1350-2060.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, ensuring to use four different colors of mana.
Lux Artillery triggers, giving Crystalline Crawler sunburst, causing it to enter with eight +1/+1 counters due to sunburst and its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{W}{W}{U}{B}{R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

193-3604-5139.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding two in any combination of {U}, {B} and/or {R}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Relic of Sauron.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-5139.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

2228-3143-4613-4762.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2228-3143-4613-4762.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

856-3967-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-6351.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

122-328-2732-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

771-1031-3098-5990-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Call to Mind or Relearn must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1031-3098-5990-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Call to Mind without paying its mana cost, targeting Relearn.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Call to Mind, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Call to Minds, causing you to return Relearn and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Relearn without paying its mana cost, targeting Call to Mind.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Relearn, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Relearns, causing you to return Call to Mind and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

372-3603-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-3603-4823.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5200-5614.notablePrerequisites:
Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Bighorner Rancher
5200-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Bighorner Rancher
Repeat.
5200-5614.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.

1456-5033-5078-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1456-5033-5078-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3946-4426-5155.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

539-1659-2232-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2661-3327-4517.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2661-3327-4517.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Activate Dark-Dweller Oracle by paying {1} and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Dark-Dweller Oracle ability, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to play it this turn.
Repeat.

2034-3889-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Callous Bloodmage, adding {C}{C}.
Callous Bloodmage dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Callous Bloodmage from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Callous Bloodmage enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain one life.
Repeat.

1512-1912-2816-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Stonybrook Schoolmaster does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle and Paradise Mantle attached to Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
1512-1912-2816-4474.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {1}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

262-603-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
262-603-4050.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding one mana of any color.
The Elemental dies, triggering Galvanic Juggernaut, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Repeat.

864-2564-4231-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

11-1467-1987-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell with Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
11-1467-1987-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Ghostly Flicker.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Ghostly Flicker, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Gilded Lotus, and returning the original Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

148-4703.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, getting a +1/+1 counter and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card for each damage dealt.
Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step.
Repeat until you have no cards left in library or have won the game.
